messages:
maria-support: FYI acme-prod on Dedicated is seeing a large fraction of requests 429/503 during a traffic burst. Customers report 30-90s perceived stalls. Opening thread for triage. @jon-engruntime can you join?
jon-engruntime: jumping in. Do we have timeline + probe logs?
maria-support: started ~09:12 UTC, spike to 350 qps. Support logs show many requests queued, and scale-up events in control plane but worker pods stuck in ContainerCreating. Kube events show ImagePullBackOff + failed mount due to iam:AccessDenied on service-account token.
alex-platform: that looks like the new repo-auth rollout combined with short-lived SA keys rotating. Might be hitting a transient IAM Deny from key rotation window. I see registry auth failures in the cluster attach logs:
```
E0421 09:12:35  scheduler.go:421] attach failed: Pull access denied for redwood-registry/acme-model:rate-limit, status=403 
api error: Get "https://registry.internal/token": 403 Forbidden
```
sasha-sre: also seeing autoscaler requests in the control plane for extra replicas but they never transition to Ready because init containers fail pulling images. Autoscaler thinks it's still provisioning so it doesn't increase headroom, hitting minReplicas ceiling.
maria-support: customer-facing repro steps: 1) run steady 50 qps, 2) spike to 350 qps for 2 min, 3) watch first 60s window -> 429s spike. They captured HTTP logs and attach traces.
jon-engruntime: possible chain: repo auth transient -> imagepull backoff -> pods stuck in ContainerCreating -> probes/timeouts prevent readiness -> autoscaler stalls due to attach queueing and quota checks. Two mitigations: prewarm image in warmchain, or relax minReplicas temporarily.
alex-platform: can we confirm IAM rotation timeline? infra-bot, do you have token rotation events for that org?
infra-bot: (automated) iam-rotation: org=acme-corp, sa=dedicated-provisioner, rotated_at=2026-04-21T09:11:58Z, previous_key_ttl=30s, overlap_window=5s
sasha-sre: overlap window seems short and aligns with first 403s. Also noticed registries returned 429 rate-limit after first retries, amplifying failures.
maria-support: customer wants root cause and repro steps to avoid. Also they asked why autoscaler didn't compensate sooner.
jon-engruntime: autoscaler metrics show it triggers add but respects attach backoff policy. There's a backoff cap for attach failures 30s -> 2m hysteresis to avoid noisy neighbor storms. In this case the backoff masked real capacity shortfall. We should tweak policy for transient IAM 403 -> treat as retryable vs terminal.
alex-platform: propose short-term: manual increase of minReplicas for acme-prod to absorb peak + pre-pull images on warmchain. Long-term: classify registry 403 due to rotation as retryable, and record token-rotation events into control plane to suppress attach backoff.
maria-support: steps I'm going to propose to customer: 1) bump minReplicas by +3 for next 48h, 2) enable warmchain pre-pull for their model pool, 3) we will patch autoscaler policy to reduce attach backoff on transient IAM errors and follow up with changelog.
sasha-sre: I'll open infra ticket to extend rotation overlap to 60s for service accounts used by provisioning, and whitelist the registry calls during rotation window.
jon-engruntime: to reproduce internally:
```bash
# generate steady load
wrk -t2 -c50 -d60s http://acme-prod.example/v1/generate
# then burst
wrk -t8 -c800 -d60s http://acme-prod.example/v1/generate
# meanwhile force SA rotate via infra API (dev only)
infractl iam rotate --org acme-corp --sa dedicated-provisioner --force
```
maria-support: thanks. I'll send customer the mitigation steps + ETA for autoscaler policy change. tagging @alex-platform and @sasha-sre to track rollout. :thumbsup:
alex-platform: I'll draft the policy change and link to internal PR.
sasha-sre: creating infra ticket and will post updates here when rotation overlap increased.
infra-bot: (automated) ticket created: INF-12468 "Extend SA rotation overlap for provisioning" assigned to infra-team, priority P2
maria-support: closing loop—will update thread after we confirm fixes and customer stabilizes.
